statement: For every fundamental localizer containing W1 a category is total exactly when it is aspherical
notes: Includes the empty category; no accessibility hypothesis

statement: Above W1 totality of a presheaf is equivalent to asphericity and totality of its element category
notes: Includes empty presheaves; strict and total functor and sieve classes coincide

statement: Above W1 strict and total sieve composition hold exactly when every nonempty category is aspherical
notes: Failure has a classical first factor and a terminal-object extension second factor
